additionalMentions.name: Hawaii
additionalMentions.evidence: A heading reading HAWAII appears before Planned Trips. The adjacent body is lorem ipsum and the photo depicts a printmaking studio, so neither timing nor a completed visit can be reliably inferred.

additionalMentions.name: Nicaragua
additionalMentions.evidence: The identical June 2020 heading occurs once above and once below Planned Trips. Nicaragua itself is explicitly in the visited-country list, but this month must not be attached as a verified completed-trip date.

plannedTrips.name: Nicaragua
plannedTrips.evidence: Listed under Planned Trips in the old source; no evidence that this dated plan was completed. It may be an unfinished duplicate.
